facts.text: Haricots verts is French for green beans and names the thin French type; green beans are the young pods of the common bean, Phaseolus vulgaris, which came to the world from Mexico and the Andes; the stringless pod was bred in the nineteenth century; cooked briefly they stay bright green with a snap, cooked long they go soft and olive coloured. Blanching and shocking in iced water keep the colour.
